title: N3 jmap-server: PushSubscription/set + gates
description: /set create/update/destroy, https url, immutables, constant-time verification (subtle), expires clamp MAX 7 days echoed, no ifInState; is_deliverable; state_change_for types filter; pub seconds formatter on civil_from_days (D7); trait MUST docs (cap/overQuota, CSPRNG code, consumer MUSTs). See JMAP-nbk3 design field (approved plan) for scope, acceptance and quoted RFC/draft lines.
notes:
Implemented (uncommitted): PushSubscription/set (create/update/destroy, https url, immutables compared after patching per rfc8620.txt:2141-2145, constant-time code check via subtle, expires limited to MAX_PUSH_EXPIRY_SECS=7d and echoed), is_deliverable, state_change_for, utc_date_from_epoch_seconds (D7), trait create/update/destroy with MUST docs, StateChange::new in jmap-types. All 10 push_subscription_set tests pass; N2 mock gained unreachable stubs for the new required trait methods. Follow-ups: JMAP-yt1w.40, JMAP-yt1w.41.
Review fix: PushSubscription/set now calls list_push_subscriptions before the create loop (only when update is non-empty), so a list failure is a method-level serverFail with nothing committed (RFC 8620 §3.6.2, rfc8620.txt:1158-1160). Regression test list_failure_returns_server_fail_without_committing_create in tests/push_subscription_set.rs (mock gains a fail_list flag, default false). Gates green.
Done in 438c3bde: tests create_returns_id_and_clamped_expires_without_account_id_or_state, create_with_non_https_url_is_invalid_properties, create_with_verification_code_is_invalid_properties, backend_policy_rejection_of_keyless_create_passes_through_verbatim, update_of_immutable_property_is_invalid_properties, update_with_wrong_verification_code_is_invalid_properties, verify_then_extend_expires_keeps_verification_and_clamps, destroy_removes_subscription, is_deliverable_requires_verified_and_unexpired, state_change_for_filters_by_types; changed existing tests: MockBackend impl PushSubscriptionBackend (used by all 4 tests in the file)
